mapper.select: select t1.id, cast(t1.out_trade_no as char) out_trade_no, t1.trade_no, t1.pay_channel, t1.total_amount, t1.pay_status, date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') create_time, date_format(t1.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') update_time from order_pay t1 where t1.user_id = #{userId} order by t1.create_time desc, t1.id desc

select t1.id, cast(t1.book_id as char) book_id, t1.book_name, cast(t1.book_index_id as char) book_index_id, t1.book_index_name, t1.buy_amount, date_format(t1.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') create_time from user_buy_record t1 where t1.user_id = #{userId} order by t1.create_time desc, t1.id desc
